A closer look at MINRON.

The product’s nutritional focus connects mineral intake with skeletal development and the needs of laying and growing birds. A useful assessment considers the complete ration, water and other mineral supplements before deciding whether additional supplementation is appropriate.

What is in the formulation?

ComponentAvailable formulation detail
Macro-mineralsPhosphorus, calcium, magnesium, sodium and potassium
Trace elementsIron, zinc, manganese, copper, cobalt and selenium
Additional named componentsCholine chloride and vitamin B₁₂
Ingredient concentrationsRequest the quantified specification

The product’s care focus.

  • Macro-minerals including calcium, phosphorus and magnesium are listed.
  • Trace elements include zinc, manganese, iron, copper, cobalt and selenium.
  • Choline chloride and vitamin B₁₂ are also named on the presentation.

Presentation, route and administration.

The label identifies administration through drinking water.

Product-specific directions

A complete numerical dose is not legible in the supplied material. Ask the veterinary team for the exact mixing rate and course for the intended species and ration.

Build a more useful care conversation.

Prepare these details when discussing MINRON with your veterinary team.

  • Review the mineral content of the complete diet and other supplements.
  • Discuss the needs of layers, growing birds and farm animals separately.
  • Confirm the quantified composition and preparation instructions.

Before you take the next step.

What should I request for MINRON?+

Ask for the current product specification, the available pack size and directions for your species and market. For a commercial enquiry, include your organisation, country and the quantity or documentation you need.

Does a care category establish suitability for my animal?+

No. The exact formulation, animal’s condition and local product authorisation matter. The treating veterinarian should confirm suitability, administration and any applicable food-production withdrawal requirements.

For veterinary professionals. Product information is an overview; the current locally authorised instructions and prescribing veterinarian determine use. Pack presentation may vary.
